commands.assertions: A signed channel relay route completes when direct peer connectivity is unavailable; the owner receipt records route name, provider cost units, measured latency, preserves them through reconciliation, and upgrades an existing SQLite journal with telemetry columns.

assertions: Fallback route is explicitly identified as sse-relay rather than inferred from peer connectivity.
Cost is recorded in provider-defined opaque units.
Latency is measured from route submission until terminal receipt and is bounded to a positive value.
Reconciliation returns the same route telemetry as the original receipt.
limitations: This focused fixture proves the supported relay adapter and telemetry contract on linux-x64-x11; a live WAN relay provider remains outside the local acceptance environment.
